title: Idea: Homepage hire-path tightening
description:
Parked for committee discussion. Do not implement until Ryan or Publicist says go.

Continues the parked hire-path brief (1b53c5) after the recent homepage pass. Hero H1 stays "Depend on proven experts." This is sequence and deletion, not new messaging.

Proposed tightening:
1. Cut B0rd from the homepage. It sits between Platform and the case studies and sends people to hardware, Etsy, and a spinoff story. B0rd already has a strip; do not also feature it on the hire path.
2. One contact button. Keep the hero "Tell us the problem." Change Approach "Contact us" to a text link to the Cybernetic Development article.
3. Make the case cards scannable: who / what broke / what you did / one number. Call Criteria and Venue Driver already have the stories; they still read as paragraphs.
4. Cheap copy cleanup: homepage page-level SEO still says "In production since 2023" (fights the 14-year line). Replace "Please see our Posts for more" with shorter voice.

Related, do not treat as the same ask: if the touch-page wiggle stays gone, consider dropping body { touch-action: pan-y } later (it can block pinch-zoom). Keep overflow-x hidden.

Do not reopen the hero rewrite.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-09-26: proceed. Implementing items 1 to 4 now under epic a65429, with the hero button retargeted to the new /engage page. H1 unchanged.
